using System;
using System.Reflection;
using System.Text.Json;

struct Vector3 { public float x,y,z; }
class Transform { public Vector3 position; }
static class Time { public static float fixedDeltaTime = 0.02f; }
static class Mathf { public static float Min(float a,float b) { return Math.Min(a,b); } public static float Abs(float a) { return Math.Abs(a); } }
class Health { public bool IsDead; }
class Character { public Health Health = new Health(); public float CurrentStamina; public void UseStamina(float v) { CurrentStamina=Math.Max(0,CurrentStamina-v); } }
class Movement { public Vector3 velocity { get; set; } }
class Tuning { public float StaminaDrainPerSecond=50; public float SlowDescentStaminaDrainPerSecond=30; public float SlowDescentSpeed=-0.8f; public float UpwardAcceleration=10f/0.3f; public float MaxUpwardSpeed=10; }
abstract class ActionRoot { protected abstract void OnUpdateAction(float deltaTime); }
abstract class EquipmentAbilityAction : ActionRoot {
    protected Character characterController = new Character();
    protected float actionElapsedTime;
    protected bool Running=true;
    protected Tuning config = new Tuning();
    protected Tuning GetConfig() { return config; }
    protected virtual bool ShouldAutoConsumeStamina() { return true; }
    protected virtual void OnStaminaDepleted() { StopAction(); }
    protected virtual void OnAbilityUpdate(float deltaTime) { }
    protected void StopAction() { Running=false; }
    protected void LogIfVerbose(string message) { }
    protected void PauseGroundConstraint(float v) { }
    public void RenderStep(float dt) { OnUpdateAction(dt); }
    /* BASE_POLICY */
    /* BASE_METHOD */
}
class CA_Flight : EquipmentAbilityAction {
    private int spaceHeldCount,spaceReleaseCount;
    private bool isSlowDescending;
    private float currentUpwardSpeed,pendingVerticalDelta;
    private object flightPlatform = new object();
    private readonly Transform characterTransform=new Transform();
    private readonly Movement movement=new Movement();
    private static PropertyInfo velocityProperty=typeof(Movement).GetProperty("velocity");
    public bool Held=true;
    public bool UseFallback;
    public CA_Flight(float stamina) { characterController.CurrentStamina=stamina; }
    private bool IsFlightInputHeld() { return Held; }
    private Transform GetCharacterTransform() { return characterTransform; }
    private object GetCharacterMovement() { return UseFallback?null:movement; }
    public void PhysicsStep() { UpdateFlightPlatform(); }
    public bool IsRunning { get { return Running; } }
    public bool Descending { get { return isSlowDescending; } }
    public int ReleaseFrames { get { return spaceReleaseCount; } }
    public float PendingSpeed { get { return pendingVerticalDelta; } }
    public float VelocityY { get { return movement.velocity.y; } }
    public float Height { get { return characterTransform.position.y; } }
    /* FLIGHT_POLICY */
    /* FLIGHT_METHODS */
}
class Program {
 static void Main() {
    var emptyHeld=new CA_Flight(0);
    emptyHeld.RenderStep(0.02f);
    emptyHeld.PhysicsStep();
    var emptyReleased=new CA_Flight(0) { Held=false };
    for(int i=0;i<8;i++) emptyReleased.RenderStep(0.02f);
    var smallReleased=new CA_Flight(0.4f) { Held=false };
    smallReleased.RenderStep(0.001f);
    var physics=new CA_Flight(100);
    physics.RenderStep(0.02f);
    float target=physics.PendingSpeed;
    physics.PhysicsStep(); float first=physics.VelocityY;
    physics.PhysicsStep(); float second=physics.VelocityY;
    var fallback=new CA_Flight(100) { UseFallback=true };
    fallback.RenderStep(0.02f); float expectedPerStep=fallback.PendingSpeed*Time.fixedDeltaTime;
    fallback.PhysicsStep(); float heightOne=fallback.Height;
    fallback.PhysicsStep(); float heightTwo=fallback.Height;
    if (!emptyHeld.Descending || emptyHeld.VelocityY >= 0 || emptyReleased.IsRunning || first != target || second != target || Math.Abs(heightTwo - 2*heightOne)>0.000001f) throw new Exception("flight regression");
    Console.WriteLine(JsonSerializer.Serialize(new {
       source_methods="verbatim; stubs cover stamina, input, transform and velocity property; no Unity renderer/physics simulated",
       INT08=new { at_zero_descending=emptyHeld.Descending, at_zero_velocity_y=emptyHeld.VelocityY,
          expected_descending_velocity=-0.8f, release_frames_after_8_updates=emptyReleased.ReleaseFrames,
          still_running_after_8_released_updates=emptyReleased.IsRunning, positive_stamina_control_release_frames=smallReleased.ReleaseFrames },
       INT09=new { target_speed=target, first_physics_speed=first, second_physics_speed=second,
          expected_per_physics_step=expectedPerStep, fallback_height_after_one_step=heightOne, fallback_height_after_two_steps=heightTwo },
       fixed_behavior=true
    },new JsonSerializerOptions { WriteIndented=true }));
 }
}
